extra.title: Missing Authorization Check - Unauthorized Product Enumeration (IDOR)
extra.assessment: New discovery - This is a valid IDOR vulnerability where unauthenticated users can enumerate all products (IDs 1-5) without authentication checks. Not in expected findings but represents a significant security issue that should have been included.

extra.title: Horizontal IDOR - Unauthorized Access to Product Data via Direct Object Reference
extra.assessment: New discovery - Duplicate/variant of the product enumeration IDOR finding with additional analysis. Confirms same underlying vulnerability with comprehensive testing methodology.

extra.title: CSRF + Wildcard CORS - Unauthorized Cart Manipulation via Cross-Origin Requests
extra.assessment: New discovery - This is a valid security vulnerability allowing cross-origin requests to modify victims' carts without CSRF tokens. Not in expected findings but represents a significant business logic and access control vulnerability.

extra.title: IDOR Vulnerability: Unprotected Order Access via Sequential IDs
extra.assessment: New discovery - Structural IDOR vulnerability where orders can be accessed without authorization checks. While order creation may not be functional, the endpoint structure is definitively vulnerable and represents a critical authorization bypass.

extra.title: Information Disclosure via Public API Documentation Endpoint
extra.assessment: New discovery - Sensitive API documentation and coupon codes are disclosed without authentication, including hints about exploitable functionality. This information disclosure enables attackers to systematically identify vulnerabilities.

extra.title: Cart Remove-Coupon Endpoint Input Validation Vulnerability (No-Op Endpoint)
extra.assessment: New discovery - The remove-coupon endpoint accepts invalid input (empty, missing, or SQL injection patterns) and always returns success without validation. Represents inconsistent input validation across related endpoints.

extra.title: Large Quantity Values Bypass Stock Availability Checks
extra.assessment: New discovery - The endpoint accepts arbitrarily large quantity values (999999999) without inventory validation, allowing out-of-stock purchases. Represents missing input boundary validation.

extra.title: Zero Quantity Accepted Without Validation
extra.assessment: New discovery - The endpoint accepts quantity=0 without validation, allowing nonsensical cart states. While lower impact than negative quantities, represents a validation gap in numeric input handling.
